resources.string: To lock apps, App Lock needs to be switched on in Accessibility settings. It only checks which app is open. It never reads your screen.

1. Tap Turn on, find App Lock (it may be under \"Downloaded apps\" or \"Installed apps\") and switch it on.\n2. Switch greyed out or says \"Restricted setting\"? Open App info, tap ⋮ in the top corner, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try step 1 again.
On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones, also open App info → Other permissions and allow \"Display pop-up windows while running in the background\".

App Lock uses this to notice when you open an app you chose to lock, so it can ask for your PIN or fingerprint. It only looks at which app is open. It never reads what\'s on your screen and never sends anything anywhere.
